verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms an official Muse mobile app exists (App Store listing, reviews) and it's described as full-featured with permissions, avatar customization, goals, and integrations, but evidence is Apple App Store only with no explicit confirmation of an Android app or feature parity across platforms. missing for 10: explicit Android app evidence, feature-parity confirmation across iOS/Android, independent hands-on mobile app reviews beyond app store testimonials.
